snippet.title: Avatar Drop (9/3/2009)
snippet.description:
Official description: Ever want to watch your Xbox Live Avatar plummet helplessly through the air and smash into things? Well now you can in the humorously cruel new game "Avatar Drop"! You and your friends can experience the side-splitting hilarity of watching your digital alter-egos bump, scream and crash their way through random obstacles.

RELEASE DATE: 9/3/2009
DEVELOPER: Sangco Studios LLC
GENRE: Family
Offline players 1 - 4
